The Kubernetes Deployment uses the fixed aws-otel-eks namespace name and has no dependency on the namespace resource, so Terraform may create it before the namespace exists. Reference the namespace resource to enforce creation order.

The sidecar Deployment specifies the namespace by a constant name but does not depend on its namespace resource. When both are created together, the Deployment can be applied before the namespace exists.

When this IRSA module creates its namespace, the ServiceAccount still uses only the namespace input string and does not wait for that namespace resource. Kubernetes can reject ServiceAccount creation if the namespace is not yet present.

The KEDA IRSA ServiceAccount is configured with a module-created namespace, but its namespace attribute is only the input string. Add a dependency on the namespace resource to prevent creation before that namespace exists.
